text:
Anya: quick sync prototyping a 'burst guardrail' next to Burst Max: a small safety cap that prevents accidental huge spikes unless you toggle 'override'. figma: https://figma.com/s/abcd Priya: nice. is that per-pool or tenant-level? Anya: per-pool by default; tenant-level setting in Advanced. simpler UX and safer defaults. Matt: can we show an inline cost delta while dragging min/max? tiny chip: '+~$0.08/hr' so folks see impact immediately. Julian: +1 on cost chip. also suggest an info tooltip with quick example math. Sarah: accessibility: slider thumb label contrast fails on dark theme. need at least 4.5:1. also label overlaps at narrow widths. Kofi: keyboard rules proposed: arrow = 1, shift+arrow = 10, pageup/pagedown = 25, double-left/right = jump to suggested default. escape = revert to committed values. Anya: good keyboard rules. also microcopy change for the confirmation modal. current: 'Apply burst?' too vague. propose: 'Temporarily increase GPU pool to X for Y minutes. Estimated cost: $Z. Proceed?' Matt: add a small link/icon to open the cost estimator from modal. Sarah: screen reader note: add aria-valuetext on SLO slider like 'Latency SLO: 95th percentile target 200ms'. Design linter flagged missing attr. DesignBot: accessibility lint: slider missing aria-valuetext. suggestion: ```html
``` Priya: UX question: if user switches pools and that would exceed the safety cap, do we block or show a soft warning + suggestions? Anya: soft warning + one-click suggested alternatives (lower burst, pick different pool). blocking only for hard policy violations. Julian: telemetry: record if override was used and whether they accepted suggestion. helps tune defaults. Kofi: pool picker: surface 'preemptible' with an icon + accessible label, not just color. aria-label like 'Pool r5g (preemptible)'. Sarah: also ensure focus order in the burst modal: primary CTA, then override toggle, then cancel. mention to devs. Matt: minor: default safety cap = 2x current committed capacity? avoids huge runaway costs but gives headroom. Anya: I'll set default to 2x and make editable per-pool. updating mockups now. Priya: can we show an inline small 'expected latency impact' tag when they pick a smaller pool? helps PM tradeoffs. Anya: noted will add cost + latency delta chips in next frame. DesignBot: deploy-bot: new figma frame uploaded by Anya at 2146030028 Kofi: tiny follow-up: keyboard hint area in the modal footer would be great for discoverability. Anya: will add short keyboard hints and push before EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:
